statement: For such an algebra B, the following statements hold. (i) Every tuple of columns of Bm with linearly independent reductions in Fm 2 extends to an invertible matrix. (ii) The kernel Jr(B) is central in Str(B) for r ≥ 6. (iii) For r ≥ 5, the group Er(B) is normal in GLr(B), and the natural maps GLr(B)/ Er(B) −→ GLr+1(B)/ Er+1(B) are isomorphisms.
